verdict.rationale: Docusign ships built-in AI features like AI-Assisted Review's 'AI-powered chat' for flagging risky language, drafting clauses, and suggesting redlines, plus AI-Assisted Summary/Q&A within eSignature (docs-20, docs-25, docs-33, docs-16). These represent task delegation to an embedded assistant rather than a generic chatbot, but the story's broader 'delegate tasks' framing is only partially matched — most AI capability documentation centers on document analysis/drafting, not a general-purpose in-app assistant, and there's no independent/hands-on verification of its assistant behavior. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the AI assistant reliably completes delegated tasks, broader scope beyond contract review/summarization, and no community evidence validating the assistant's actual performance.
